description: This file defines an interface for resolving authentication schemes within AWS SDK for PHP, specifically related to request signing and authentication method selection.

classes.name: AuthSchemeResolverInterface
classes.description: An interface that specifies a method to select an authentication scheme for request signing based on available schemes and credentials.

methods.name: selectAuthScheme
methods.description: Selects an authentication scheme for request signing from a priority-ordered list, using provided credentials.
